description: Deploy script that rebuilds the image per environment, restarts all hosts at once, and runs a destructive migration in-line; a correct answer promotes one immutable artifact, rolls out gradually behind health checks, and makes the migration rollback-safe.

platform-engineer.task: Design a safer deployment and rollback approach for the service in `{fixture}/` (see `{fixture}/scripts/deploy.sh`, `{fixture}/migrations/`, and `{fixture}/context.md`) before release 2.3 ships. Do not write files; give your recommendation in your final answer.

rubricPoints.requirement: Identifies that `deploy.sh` rebuilds the image per environment from `git pull` with a mutable tag, and recommends building one immutable image (tagged by commit SHA or version) once and promoting that same image from staging to production.
Replaces the restart-all-hosts-at-once loop with a rolling, canary, or blue-green rollout that checks `/healthz` (or error metrics) before moving to more hosts.
Defines rollback as redeploying the previous immutable image tag, without rebuilding from an old commit.
Identifies that migration 0019 drops the `address` column, so the 2.2 image cannot run after it, and recommends expand/contract: keep `address` in 2.3 and drop it in a later release.
